feeds.title: Power Living Blog
feeds.description: Power Living Blog contains articles on yoga, meditation, nutrition & yoga philosophy. Power Living is one of the largest yoga communities in Australasia.

feeds.title: Byron Yoga » Yogi Wisdom
feeds.description: Byron Yoga Centre was established in 1988 by John Ogilvie and is one of the longest running yoga schools in Australia. Byron Yoga Centre is now at home at Byron Yoga Retreat Centre, the tranquil eco haven is ideal for a retreat or for a teacher training course. Affordable and authentic yoga for all levels in beautiful Byron Bay.

feeds.title: Cultivate Calm Yoga Blog
feeds.description: The best place to start yoga is here. Beginner-friendly Vinyasa, Yin Yoga, and Meditation classes in East Brisbane. Here we share our thoughts and musings on all things yoga, meditation, emotional & mental health.

feeds.title: Zenergy Yoga Blog
feeds.description: You can read our blog for Important and relevant topics on the benefits of yoga for children and teens. We've gathered several of Loraine's blogs here to help and support you on your journey. Zenergy Yoga is the longest running, most experienced and highest regarded provider of children's yoga education in Australia.

feeds.title: Kundalini House Blog
feeds.description: Read our yoga and health blog to gain more knowledge about pregnancy conditions, yoga philosophy and more about our health clinic services. Kundalini House was established by sisters, Pip Atherstone-Reid and Billie Atherstone, who had a combined vision to create a space where they could work together in an environment that stood for conscious healthy living with a commitment to developing an authentic relationship with the Self and others.

feeds.title: Mental Health Aware Yoga Blog
feeds.description: The latest posts from the Mental Health Aware Yoga blog provides Professional Mental Health Training for Yoga Teachers. Dr Lauren Tober developed this innovative Mental Health Aware Yoga training to support Yoga Teachers to make their classes safe, nourishing and transformative for all students, including those experiencing mental health challenges.

feeds.title: WONDER YOGA
feeds.description: Discover the wonders of yoga with the help of our blog and find out everything you need to know about yoga. With Wonder Yoga, explore a dynamic range of yoga and barre class led by teachers who will challenge and support you to find what you need to feel strong, balanced, calm and capable.

feeds.title: The Happydemic Blog
feeds.description: Find out so much more about Laughter Yoga, its benefits and many related issues that Laughter Yoga can impact in The Happidemic Blog! The Happydemic is a social enterprise, a small business network with a big community heart. Heather Joy Campbell trained with Laughter Yoga's founder Dr Kataria in India and has facilitated community laughter workshops and workplace sessions all over Queensland.

feeds.title: Santosha Yoga Australia
feeds.description: The Santosha Yoga Australia Blog gives you information on how yoga is helpful for maintaining good health, and helps you slow down, become calm and connect to your Self. I'm Danielle, the face behind Santosha Yoga Australia. I am passionate about helping you find ease in your body and mind.

feeds.title: Yoga for Good
feeds.description: Yoga For Good helps you live your best life through yoga. Check out our blog to know more about it. Our mission is to be a platform for innovative programs and projects benefiting communities through yoga principles and practices for a purposeful, peaceful life.

feeds.title: Yoga Synergy Blog
feeds.description: Established by Simon Borg Olivier & Bianca Machliss in 1984, Yoga Synergy is one of Sydney's largest and most respected yoga schools. Yoga Synergy offers tips that can help improve your yoga. Read through our blogs and start living life with a healthy body and mind.

feeds.title: Yoga Corner Blog
feeds.description: Yoga Corner is your oasis in the heart of the city. We offer Hot Yoga, Vinyasa Yoga, Yin Yoga, Jivamukti Yoga, Prenatal Yoga Meditation classes in our boutique studio space tucked away in the heart of Melbourne's CBD.

feeds.title: Australian Yoga Academy Blog
feeds.description: Australian Yoga Academy, Prahran, is Melbourne's best Premier Yoga Studio, offering Classes, Teacher Training, Workshops in a world class space. Australian Yoga Academy has been assisting people to raise their consciousness, transform their lives and maximise their potential spiritually, mentally and physically since 2000.

feeds.title: Face Yoga Australia Blog
feeds.description: The Face Yoga Australia Blog provides useful information on how you can keep your body healthy and look your best. Read the blog to know more. Face Yoga Australia offers 100% natural solutions to take years off your face, and boost your energy and confidence.

feeds.title: Yoga NRG + Mindfulness Training Australia Blog
feeds.description: From your very first Yoga NRG class, you start feeling better simply because your body & mind has just begun to become cleaner or less cluttered. Read our blog to know more about yoga and its benefits. Yoga NRG gives you the tools to better manage your energy, physically, mentally and develop confidence and clarity for your own personal aspirations.

feeds.title: Love Life. Live Yoga. Blog
feeds.description: Check out our blog to get to know about our yoga program and much more on yoga. Love Life. Live Yoga. brings you luxury yoga retreats and yoga workshops worldwide.

feeds.title: The Yoga Institute Blog
feeds.description: Find out the latest news and views from The Yoga Institute in Sydney, featuring articles from our yoga teacher training, yoga psychology and yoga therapy faculty. The Yoga Institute is a dedicated centre for education in yoga. Passionate about yoga and the benefits it brings to peoples' lives, our team is committed to providing yoga teachers and yoga teacher training students with a highly engaging learning experience.

feeds.title: Exhale Yoga Blog
feeds.description: The Exhale Yoga Blog teaches you about the many health benefits of yoga. At Exhale our teachers are committed to supporting you in learning this wonderful skill with life-changing potential when practiced regularly. We encourage you to strive for continual improvement in your technique and finally integrate the yoga teachings into your everyday life.

feeds.title: WellBeing Magazine » Yoga
feeds.description: Australia's most comprehensive online natural therapy guide featuring natural health articles, events, practitioner listings, courses, schools and colleges. Find out more by following blog.

feeds.title: Yoga Australia Blog
feeds.description: Yoga Australia is not-for profit voluntary run association recognised as the industry peak body for yoga in Australia and has the highest teaching standards anywhere in the world. The primary mission of the organisation is to develop and promote best practice for Yoga teaching, to support and represent Australian teachers from all styles and traditions and to educate and inform the general public and professional community about the benefits of Yoga.
